next.PENDING_VERIFICATION: The bank is checking your documents. We will email you when it is done.
next.VERIFIED: Your documents are fine. The bank is preparing your contract.
next.WAITING_CONTRACT: Your contract is being prepared. Sign it with your bank manager.
next.APPROVED: Your contract is signed. Two bank admins will switch your account on shortly.
next.ACTIVE: You are live. Create an API client so your website can take payments.
next.SUSPENDED: Your account is paused. Contact the bank to find out why and how to restore it.
next.TERMINATED: This account is closed and can no longer take payments.
next.REJECTED: The bank could not approve this account. Contact the bank for details.

landing.title: Take card payments on your website
landing.subtitle: Sign up, verify your email, and the bank takes it from there: documents, contract, and two-admin activation.

card.title: Card data stays with the bank
card.text: Buyers type their card on the bank’s own page.

people.title: Checked by two people
people.text: Two bank admins approve every merchant before it goes live.

keys.title: Keys for your servers
keys.text: Create API clients and rotate their secrets yourself.

signup.title: Create a merchant account
signup.subtitle: We will email you a code to confirm the address.
signup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent. It works for a few minutes.
verify.sent: A new code is on its way
verify.doneText: Sign in with your email and password. The bank will now check your documents.

clients.title: API clients
clients.description: Your servers use these to get access tokens (OAuth2 client credentials).
clients.emptyText: Create one for each server or environment that calls the bank.
clients.lockedTitle: API clients open when you are live
clients.lockedText: Once two bank admins activate your account, you can create keys for your servers here.
clients.rotateText: The current secret stops working immediately. Update your servers right after.
clients.onceWarning: This is the only time you will see this secret. Store it in your server's secret manager now.
clients.stored: I have stored the secret safely

partner.noActions: Nothing to do in this status.
partner.contractHint: As printed on the signed contract
partner.reasonShort: Write at least a few words
partner.emailNotVerified: The merchant hasn't verified their email yet, so documents can't be approved.

explain.verify: The documents are fine; the merchant moves on to the contract.
explain.reject: The application is refused for good.
explain.contract: Record the signed contract. The merchant becomes approved.
explain.requestActivation: Ask a second admin to switch the merchant on.
explain.suspend: Pause payments until the problem is solved.

partner.requested: Activation requested. Another admin has to approve it in Approvals.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Activation requests waiting for a second admin, oldest first.
approvals.emptyText: When an admin asks to activate a merchant, it shows up here for someone else to decide.
approvals.yours: You made this request. Another admin has to decide it.

role.title: This area isn't for your account
role.partner: Merchant pages open once your email is verified. If you just verified it, sign out and sign in again.
role.admin: Only bank staff can open the admin console.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be old or mistyped.

errors.title: Not done
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
